name: What is the typical lifespan of different roofing materials?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of different roofing materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a roof varies significantly based on the material. Asphalt shingle roofs, common in areas like Huntington Beach and Irvine, typically last 15-30 years. Metal roofs offer greater durability, often lasting 40-70 years. Tile roofs, including concrete and clay, can last 50 years or more, making them a long-term investment. Wood shake roofs usually last 20-40 years, while flat or low-slope roofs using TPO or PVC membranes have a lifespan of 15-30 years. Regular maintenance can help extend the life of any roofing material.
acceptedAnswer.description: Asphalt shingles last 15-30 years, metal 40-70, and tile 50+ years. Lifespan varies by material type. Regular maintenance helps extend roof life.
